title: rqt tools
keywords: rqt rqt_graph rqt_console rqt_reconfigure gui plugin
text: rqt hosts GUI tools as plugins: rqt_graph draws which nodes talk over which topics, rqt_console shows and filters log messages, and parameter and topic plugins inspect a running system. rqt_graph shows only connections that discovery has matched, so a missing line is a hint to check names, types, QoS and the domain.
